name: Spellbinding Soprano
oracle_text:
Whenever this creature attacks, instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn cost {1} less to cast.
Encore {3}{R} ({3}{R}, Exile this card from your graveyard: For each opponent, create a token copy that attacks that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature attacks, instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn cost {1} less to cast.

needs.what: a one-shot op installed by a resolving trigger that discounts EVERY spell its player casts for the rest of the turn (not just the next one) by a flat generic amount, narrowed by card types (here Instant or Sorcery), written to the player's timed table with duration this_turn so it outlives the source -- the timed form of the spell_cost_reduction static, as grant_flash_permission is of cast_as_though_flash
needs.why_existing_wont_do: next_spell_cost_reduction (amount, player, types) is single-use: the player's next matching cast spends it, so a second instant this turn would pay full price. The spell_cost_reduction static covers every spell but lasts only while a permanent carries it; granting it to the Soprano with grant_ability duration this_turn would end the discount when the attacking creature dies in combat, which the printed effect survives (611.2a)
